typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		number as string,
		state as string,
		u_classification as string,
		u_ldc_type as string,
		u_billable as string,
		watch_list as string,
		short_description as string,
		description as string,
		sys_updated_on as string,
		{contact email} as string,
		opened_at as string,
		closed_at as string,
		{service_offering name} as string,
		{business_service name} as string,
		sys_created_by as string,
		u_time_charged as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		ClosedAt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Uldctype as string,
		Description as string,
		BusinessServiceName as string,
		FName as string,
		Watchlist as string,
		ShortDescription as string,
		OpenedAt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		EtlUser as string,
		UtimeCharged as double,
		Ubillable as string,
		Number as string,
		State as string,
		ServiceOfferingName as string,
		ContactEmail as string,
		SysCreatedBy as string,
		Uclassification as string,
		SysUpdatedOn as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		ClosedAt = closed_at,
		Uldctype = u_ldc_type,
		Description = description,
		BusinessServiceName = {business_service name},
		FName,
		Watchlist = watch_list,
		ShortDescription = short_description,
		OpenedAt = opened_at,
		EtlUser,
		UtimeCharged = u_time_charged,
		Ubillable = u_billable,
		Number = number,
		State = state,
		ServiceOfferingName = {service_offering name},
		ContactEmail = {contact email},
		SysCreatedBy = sys_created_by,
		Uclassification = u_classification,
		SysUpdatedOn = sys_updated_on),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
